iron_warhammer.name: Iron Warhammer
iron_warhammer.note: the flat striking face is on the LEFT, the beak on the right; the neck is still centred

hammer_smear.note: ADDITIVE. The hammer's side swing. Origin = the hand; clockwise from -50 to +50 degrees, outer radius 40; mirror and scale as slash_smear. Frame 0 whole, 1 to 3 dissolve

hammer_slam_smear.note: ADDITIVE. The overhead, -80 to +20 degrees, heavier

hammer_impact.note: ADDITIVE, once. Where the head lands on the floor, seen from above; never turned. Dust ring radius about 22 (an ellipse)

hammer_hit.note: ADDITIVE, once. Where the head hits an enemy; faces right, turn it to the hit direction

momentum_ring.note: Momentum: chevrons round the feet, 6 frames: empty, then one to five lit (the code picks the frame). Additive, never turned

stagger_break.note: Stagger: the meter fills and the enemy is stunned: a hard burst on the enemy. Additive, once

stagger_stars.note: Stagger: the dazed loop over a stunned enemy's head. Additive, loops

quake_rock.note: Quake (21 November, a crack along the aim): a small burst of rock, played at a few places along the crack. Normal blending (art/blend.json), once, never turned

quake_crack.note: Quake: one piece of the crack, lying along +x; laid end to end by rune_fx.gd (kind crack). Normal blending

quake_crack_end.note: Quake: the far end of the crack, running out to a point about 26 px along. Normal blending

aftershock_crack.note: Aftershock: the ground trembling before the rumble; loop it for about half a second. About 48 across and 30 up and down. Additive, never turned

aftershock_burst.note: Aftershock: the rumble, on the same patch. Additive, once, never turned

quake_erupt.note: Quake: rock and light thrown up under the enemy; origin = the enemy's feet, about 28 across on the floor. Additive, once, never turned

bulwark_shield.note: Bulwark: the shield round the player while it lasts; origin = the player's centre. Lines only, so the player still reads. Additive, loops

bulwark_block.note: Bulwark: it stops a hit; play it where the hit landed. Additive, once

bulwark_end.note: Bulwark: the shield goes; same origin as bulwark_shield. Additive, once

stagger_fill.note: show the left part for how full the meter is

note: The hammer: all its numbers. Built like a sword: head (the blades' format) on a haft (the grips' format) with a counterweight (the pommels' format). Hand pictures have no outline. Heads are centred on the frame's middle column; their 3 px neck carries the slot dots, listed bottom-up. On a haft the hold (pivot) is 7 px down, slots below it. Weights echo the four pommels: plain iron, keen blue steel, heavy bronze, light pale ring.

stat_impact.note: Impact: how big the patch of floor a slam hits; stat_impact_hot is its lit twin

forge_note: Forge pictures: heads are centred on the 45 frame (draw at x = (45 - width) / 2); their sockets sit on the neck, bottom-up. Hafts are 45 wide with a 13 px pole; the last 9 rows under pommel_at are empty, as on the sword grips. Icons are outlined; head icons lie down, head to the right.

momentum.name: Momentum
momentum.text: Each hit you land makes the next one stronger, in five steps. Stop hitting and it drains away.

stagger.name: Stagger
stagger.text: Your hits fill a meter on the enemy. When it is full the enemy is stunned.

aftershock.name: Aftershock
aftershock.text: After your finisher the ground rumbles a moment later and hurts whatever is still near.

quake.name: Quake
quake.text: The ground erupts under the enemy nearest your aim.

bulwark.name: Bulwark
bulwark.text: For a few seconds nothing can hurt you, and whoever hits you is stunned.

runes_note: The hammer's runes. Stones in swing/runes/ (icon 26 x 26, forge 9 x 9 and _lit, hand 1 x 1 and _lit), glyphs for the actives in hud/, effect strips in fx/ (listed under fx with folder fx). Hook keeps its stone, glyph and effects.
